title: RAW_UNSCREENED: qoker/qokeedy rahmen olkain-olshedy als Paar
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f80v.33 places qokeedy/qoker immediately before olkain olshedy, while f77r.23 and f85r1.4 repeat olshedy qokeedy; a qok frame may select a two-form content pair, against a stock phrase or independent-word account.

design.scope_description: Exact f80v.32-.36, f77r.23 and f85r1.4 packet lines with all ZL/IT/RF boundaries preserved; no extrapolation to sealed or unexposed material.
design.mechanism: A qok frame links a preceding qokeedy/qoker operator to a following or neighboring ol-family pair, so terminal variation (eedy versus er) changes the relation while olkain/olshedy carry the paired content heads. This is a local argument hypothesis, not a qokeedy translation.
design.unit: Exact ordered frames qokeedy qoker olkain olshedy qokey qokeey at f80v.33 and olshedy qokeedy at f77r.23/f85r1.4; f80v.36 olshedy ... shedy is a non-qok control.
design.contrast: qok frame with a two-form content pair versus independent words or a recurrent phrase template that imposes the same order without a shared relation.
design.prediction: The frame account predicts that qokeedy/qoker positions will select the same two-form neighbor class at f80v.33 and that olshedy-qokeedy will preserve the same direction at f77r.23 and f85r1.4. A phrase-template/independent-word rival predicts order may recur only at the exact stock phrase and will not preserve the pair when qok is absent or terminally changed.
concrete_observations: f80v.33 reads qokeedy qoker olkain olshedy qokey qokeey tchcthy lom in ZL; IT has the same word array and RF preserves all eight source groups.
f77r.23 reads sheoky qokaiin chedy lchedy olshedy qokeedy chedy qokol; f85r1.4 reads odeedaiin qokechy daiin chekchy olshedy qokeedy doltshdy otar otchdy ols.
f80v.36 has ... olshedy olal shedy without qokeedy, providing the declared absent-frame control.
linked_consequences: The same ordered olshedy-to-qokeedy relation should recur at f77r.23 and f85r1.4 despite different surrounding forms.
Removing qok in the f80v.36 control should change the declared frame/slot configuration while retaining olshedy, separating qok framing from an olshedy phrase identity.
design.nearest_rival: qokeedy, qoker and olshedy form an independent stock phrase or paragraph-specific grammar; repeated order does not encode a shared argument relation.
design.distinguishing_observation: Use exact source-group order and a predeclared qok-present/qok-absent frame table; require the same direction at two physical loci plus a changed configuration in f80v.36. Do not score recurrence or reader agreement as semantic evidence.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Only one qokeedy-qoker-olkain-olshedy sequence exists, and the two shorter repeats may be a fixed phrase; qok absence may reflect unrelated content.
